name: Grove Elemental
primary:
A grove elemental appears in front of you and follows you for 60 s. At most 2 elementals serve you at once: a third one replaces the oldest. It attacks monsters nearby and whoever fights you, and never harms you or your allies.
A walking sapling. Every 2 s it heals you and your other elementals within 6 blocks by 1 ❤. Every 1.3 s it throws thorn seeds from up to 13 blocks:
• Damage 1.5 ❤ earth
• Roots in place for 2 s
self_description: The elemental appears right next to you.
